# Code of Conduct

Instead of simply referring to an obscure and lengthy Code
of Conduct, let's just say that this project has [No Code of
Conduct](https://github.com/domgetter/NCoC).  We are all adults.  Common sense
applies.  Follow the Netiquette.  Be open, considerate, and respectful of
differing viewpoints and experiences of others no matter their position within
the project.  We accept anyone's contributions.  Nothing else matters.
